name: train-cs-sk-xlmr-ce-s1
description:
RQ6, second model family: a token classifier (BIO labels per word) on XLM-RoBERTa
large, the encoder of NameTag 3 multilingual, trained with cross-entropy on the
examples of train-cs-sk-ce: every CNEC 2.0 and UNER Slovak-SNK train example and
10,000 drawn from each OpenPII 1M train split (22,308 examples with this seed).
4,200 steps of 16 (about 3.0 passes), one learning rate with linear warm-up and
decay, bf16 on an NVIDIA card. Trained on MetaCentrum (docs/metacentrum.md);
--device overrides the device, and precision must then be removed off CUDA.
